children: Intellia Therapeutics entered into a Credit Agreement to access a senior secured credit facility of up to $400 million for working capital and general corporate purposes. The company drew $75 million at closing, with additional tranches tied to FDA approval of lonvo-z, revenue milestones, and an equity raise, plus an uncommitted $100 million incremental option. Loans bear interest at 1-month SOFR (3.00% floor) plus 6.15% and mature on September 4, 2031. The facility is secured by substantially all assets, including intellectual property, and includes customary covenants and mandatory prepayment provisions.
: Five-year senior secured credit facility up to $400 million
: Enhance liquidity for working capital and corporate purposes
